Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 10068 (Part I) - 1982 

( Reaffirmed 2005 ) 
Edition 1.1 

(1989-07) 



Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PRESS WORKING DIE SETS (PLAIN TYPE) 

PART I CENTRE POST RECTANGULAR DIE SETS 

(Incorporating Amendment No 1) 



1. Scope — Covers dimensions and other requirements for (plain type) rectangular die set with two 
guide posts m central axis 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1 

3. Designation 

3.1 A centre post rectangular die set of cast iron having a die space aj x b - 100 x 80 mm with guide 
posts Type A with round ends and having length = 200 mm, and with stepped solid (Type A) guide 
bushes of Length 60 mm, shall be designated as 

Die Set C 100 x 80 IS 10068 (Part I) 
along with guide posts AR 24/25 x 200 IS 7664 
and guide bushes A-24/25 x 60 IS 8127 

3.2 A centre post rectangular die set of mild steel having a die space a^ x h = 100 x 80 mm with guide 
posts Type B with tapered ends and having length = 200 mm, and with guide bushes Type B of length 
60 mm, shall be designated as 

Die Set MS 100 x 80 IS 10068 (Part I) 
along with guide posts BT 24/25 x 200 IS 7664 
and guide bushes B 24/25 x 60 IS 8127 

3.3 A centre post rectangular die set of cast steel having a die space a\ x b = 100 x 80 mm, with guide 
posts Type B with tapered ends and having length = 200 mm, and with guide bushes Type B of length 
60 mm, shall be designated as 

Die Set S 100 x 80 IS 10068 (Part I) 
along with guide posts BT-24/25 x 200 IS 7664 
and guide bushes B-24/25 x 60 IS 8127 

3.4 A centre post rectangular die set of mild steel having a die space a\* b = 100 x 80 mm, with guide 
posts Type A with round ends and having length = 200 mm, and with guide bushes Type C shall be 
designated as 

Die Set MS100 x 80 IS 10068 (Part I) 
along with guide posts AR 24/25 x 100 IS 7664 
and guide bushes C 24/25 IS 8127 

4. Material — The top and bottom tool holders shall be made of mild steel of IS 226 1975 
'Specification for structural steel (standard quality) ( fifth revision Y or of cast iron of grade FG 260 of 
IS 210-1978 'Specification for grey iron casting ( third revision Y or cast steel of grade 23 45 of 
IS 1030-1974 'Specification for carbon steel castings for general engineering purposes ( second 
revision Y 

5. General Requirements — The top and bottom tool holders shall be free from cracks, burrs and 
pits and shall satisfy for accuracy when tested as per test chart ( under preparation ) 

6. Marking 

6.1 The designation and the manufacturer's trade-mark to appear at a prominent place on tool 
holders 

6.2 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution 



Adopted 28 January 1982
